text:
Oliver Chen: tiny personal update — eloped with Sam in Lisbon over the weekend 💍✈️. also quietly accepted a promo to Senior PM this morning. low-key celebrating with a potluck this Friday in the kitchen — can anyone bring tacos or a cake? :tada:
Zoe Patel: WHAT??? congrats!!! pics pls 😻📸 :heart_eyes:
Jamal Rivera: huge congrats both!! tacos + I’ll bring chips+salsa. also bringing a tiny flag that says 'we believed in you' 😂
Martha Li: omg congratulations Oliver!! Staff PM is huge, well deserved 🙌 Friday works for me, I can bring the cake — chocolate?
Anika S.: congrats!!! can we put a quick sign-up sheet? otherwise chaos. Also pls share at least one Lisbon pic so I can pin it to #random-gallery 😁
Oliver Chen: thanks y'all ❤️. here’s the drafts link for sign-up: https://tinyurl.com/ollie-potluck (just a simple gsheet) — pls add what you’re bringing. Martha chocolate cake sounds perfect.
Lina (People Ops): congrats from People Ops!! we’ll send a small e-card from the company and a promo note to your manager chain. If you want a formal announcement template, @Lina can post a blurb.
hr-bot: 🎉 Celebration logged: personal milestone (marriage) + internal promotion. People Ops will handle e-card and manager notif. HR reminders: update name/email if needed.
Zoe Patel: will someone bring napkins? last potluck was a sauce war 🍽️
Jamal Rivera: napkins + forks on me. also I'll bring a tiny Portuguese pastry for nostalgia (pastel de nata?)
Anika S.: RSVP: yes. bringing sparkling water + balloons. Also can someone remind me the time?
Oliver Chen: plan is Friday 12:30pm in the kitchen area. short toast, then back to normal chaos. if anyone wants to say a quick congrats on stage we’ll give 2 minutes of mic time 🙂
Martha Li: noted — I’ll bring candles too. congrats again Oliver!! 🎊
Zoe Patel: love this. bringing a photo frame for a candid pic to hang on the random wall if you’re okay with it :)
Oliver Chen: love it — thanks everyone. no need for gifts, just bring yourselves + tacos. photo permissions: absolutely yes, share away.
Jamal Rivera: see you Friday! 🙌
Lina (People Ops): adding a calendar invite now for 12:30 Fri. congrats again and well deserved promo :)
Oliver Chen: thanks all — you made my week. ❤️
